description: This file defines the main React application component for a dashboard frontend. It includes internal hooks for viewport detection, a desktop-only overlay component, and the main App component that manages routing and access restrictions based on viewport size.

methods.name: useIsBelowDesktopBreakpoint
methods.description: Custom hook that detects if the viewport width is below a specified breakpoint (default 1024px), updating reactively on window resize.

methods.name: DesktopOnlyOverlay
methods.description: React component that displays an overlay informing the user that the application requires a desktop environment.

methods.name: App
methods.description: Main React component that manages routing and overlays based on viewport size, and performs a development environment user verification.
